question: After the no-op pacing repair, should outbound recovery keep ambiguous rows pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Both terminal failed and recoverable pending are defensible operator behaviors; tests can prove mechanics, but maintainers must choose the durable queue-state policy.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Repair
options.body: Merge after the pacing fix and green exact-head validation if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers prefer current terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery ledger is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API surface before changing ambiguous entries to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Repair
recommendation.body: Merge after the pacing fix and green exact-head validation if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merger history on the same outbound recovery changes makes this the best available owner for the queue-state policy choice.
